svg.title: Constructing and inspecting the learned FlowSOM profile tree
svg.desc: Three stages use the same sixteen learned three-marker vectors as the FlowSOM overview. Every pair supplies one Euclidean distance in scaled, weighted measurement coordinates, giving 120 candidate connections. SOM grid positions do not restrict these candidates. Kruskal considers connections in increasing distance order and keeps those that join disconnected components. Three illustrated decisions retain 3 to 13 at 0.071 and 3 to 8 at 0.087; 8 to 13 at 0.150 would close a cycle and is skipped. Other intervening decisions are omitted from this local example. The exact computed fifteen-edge minimum spanning tree is drawn with a schematic topology layout. Node colours retain the overview’s metaclusters; the tree does not calculate them. Profile 3 is focused, and its four connected-vector distances are shown on a separate calibrated axis because drawn tree edge lengths do not encode measurement distance. All sixteen nodes remain in the tree. The values and colours are illustrative, not a tissue result.
svg.text: B Build the tree from the shortest connections
Skip: it would close a cycle
C Arrange the retained tree for review
